boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on College Avenue, El Cajon Boulevard, Montezuma Road, Art Street, and Alvarado Road in SDSU’s surrounding College Area.

cards.title: East African food on College Avenue
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to 5157 College Avenue when you want to try the shop’s documented East African menu near the South Campus Plaza edge.
cards.short_summary: A nearby counter-service stop for East African choices.
cards.evidence_claim: Flavors Express SDSU lists its address as 5157 College Avenue and describes East African food choices.
cards.access_notes: Food is sold; check the business directly for current service details.

cards.title: Groceries and flowers at South Campus Plaza
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the 5140 College Avenue store for pantry basics, produce, bakery items, and fresh flowers before heading back toward campus.
cards.short_summary: A named grocery stop beside the campus-facing College Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Trader Joe's identifies its San Diego–SDSU store at 5140 College Avenue and lists groceries, bakery items, fresh produce, and flowers.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases are required for merchandise.

cards.title: Scratch-kitchen food on College Avenue
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit the South Campus Plaza location for its documented all-American scratch-kitchen menu; choose food service appropriate to your group.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue restaurant with a food menu and indoor dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Eureka! lists its SDSU restaurant at 5140 College Avenue, Suite 111, and describes it as an all-American scratch kitchen.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant food service; this card is for dining, not alcohol service.

cards.title: A 24-hour College Avenue convenience stop
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the official 5141 College Avenue location for hot foods or mobile checkout when you need a straightforward convenience-store errand.
cards.short_summary: A named all-day convenience stop next to the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its 5141 College Avenue store as open 24/7 and identifies hot foods and mobile checkout among its features.
cards.access_notes: Purchases are optional; select only age-appropriate products.

cards.title: House-roasted coffee near SDSU
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 4653 College Avenue for the shop’s house-roasted coffee, specialty drinks, vegan pastries, and breakfast offerings.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue coffee shop with food and house-roasted beans.
cards.evidence_claim: Ultreya Coffee and Tea lists 4653 College Avenue and says it offers house-roasted coffee, specialty drinks, vegan pastries, and breakfast.
cards.source_title: Ultreya Coffee and Tea: San Diego Coffee Shop
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are sold; the official page lists daily 7 a.m.–3 p.m. hours.

cards.title: Coffee and food on El Cajon Boulevard
cards.subtitle: El Cajon Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Meet at 5900 El Cajon Boulevard for coffee and food in the café’s College location, then use its stated daily hours to plan.
cards.short_summary: A long-running College Area café on El Cajon Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: The Living Room Café identifies its College location at 5900 El Cajon Boulevard and lists food, coffee, and daily 6 a.m.–1 a.m. hours.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are sold; official site lists daily 6 a.m.–1 a.m. hours.

cards.title: Public computers and study rooms on Montezuma
cards.subtitle: Montezuma Road corridor
cards.notes: Go to 6600 Montezuma Road when you need public computers, study rooms, a community room, or the outdoor patio.
cards.short_summary: A city library with study-oriented amenities and a visible astronomy-themed building.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of San Diego lists College-Rolando Library amenities including public computers, study rooms, a community room, and outdoor space.
cards.source_title: City of San Diego: College-Rolando Library
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library hours and room availability on the City page before visiting.

cards.title: Coworking in the College Area business district
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Book a desk at this named coworking space when you need an off-campus work setting with access to nearby shopping and dining.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated coworking destination within the College Area business district.
cards.evidence_claim: College Area Business District identifies Firestation Innovation Cowork as its first coworking space and says it is near SDSU.
cards.access_notes: Desk booking or membership may be required; verify availability directly with the operator.

cards.entity_name: Walmart San Diego College Ave Supercenter
cards.title: A book aisle on lower College Avenue
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the 3412 College Avenue Supercenter’s named book department for children’s books, fiction, and history titles during store hours.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed College Avenue retail stop with a dedicated book department.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart lists a book store at its San Diego College Avenue Supercenter, 3412 College Avenue, serving 92115.
cards.source_title: Walmart: Book Store at San Diego College Ave Supercenter
cards.access_notes: Books and other store goods are sold; confirm current department availability before making a special trip.

cards.entity_name: UC San Diego Health East Station
cards.title: Green Line access on Alvarado Road
cards.subtitle: Alvarado Road corridor
cards.notes: Use this named Green Line station at 6658 Alvarado Road as a documented transit link just east of the SDSU College Area.
cards.short_summary: A nearby named Green Line station on the Alvarado Road corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: MTS lists UC San Diego Health East, formerly Alvarado, as a Green Line station at 6658 Alvarado Road.
cards.access_notes: A valid fare is required to ride; consult MTS for current schedules and fares.
